product_overview: FormLab is a local-first React form application for multi-step grant applications, with draft persistence, review, and submission handling. It also includes a failure simulation mode to demonstrate recovery from a lost response after submission.
core_goals: Complete a multi-step grant application form
Save progress as a draft and restore it later
Review entered application data before submitting
Submit the completed form to the backend
Simulate a lost response scenario to test submission recovery

features.name: Multi-step form navigation
features.description: Move through the grant application form across Applicant, Project, Budget, and Review steps while entering and reviewing information.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in application details -> Move to the next step -> Fill in project details -> Move to the next step -> Fill in budget details -> Move to the next step -> Review the JSON output
Navigate to / -> Fill in application details -> Move to the next step -> Go back to the previous step -> Update form fields -> Move forward again -> Review the updated JSON output

features.name: Draft autosave and restore
features.description: Persist in-progress form edits locally and allow the user to restore or discard a saved draft after returning to the app.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Edit form fields -> Refresh the page -> See that a saved draft is available -> Restore the draft -> Continue editing the form
Navigate to / -> Edit form fields -> Refresh the page -> See that a saved draft is available -> Discard the draft -> See the form reset to a blank state

features.name: Submission
features.description: Send the completed application to the backend for submission and handle a pending recovery state when the result is uncertain.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Complete the form -> Review the application data -> Submit the form -> See the submission status update
Navigate to / -> Complete the form -> Review the application data -> Submit the form -> See a pending recovery state -> Retry the pending submission

features.name: Failure Lab
features.description: Trigger a simulated lost response scenario after a submission has been committed, to demonstrate recovery behavior.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Complete the form -> Simulate lost response -> See the submission enter an uncertain state
